title: Minor additions, alterations, renovations and repairs.
officialText:
Minor additions, alterations, renovations and repairs to existing
mechanical systems shall meet the provisions for new construction, unless such work is done in the same manner and
arrangement as was in the existing system, is not hazardous and is approved.
